company.name: Display Factory Wholesale
company.hqAddress: No. 88 Industrial Avenue, Yinzhou District, Ningbo, Zhejiang, China
company.contacts: 销售总监：销售总监 Li Wei (liwei@example.com)；海外市场部：Chen Mei (chenmei@example.com)
company.exportHistory: 12 years exporting; overseas sales are 60% of revenue
company.systems: Excel order tracker + WeCom; no CRM in use yet
company.painPoints: Cannot tell which overseas buyers are actively purchasing now; rely on trade fairs for leads
company.growthGoals: Enter the Nordics and Benelux in 2026; add 3 distributor partners; double inquiry volume

products.customization: OEM/ODM available; logo and color customization from 200 units
products.logistics: FOB Ningbo preferred; sea freight LCL/FCL; lead time 25-35 days
products.seasonality: Peak orders March-May for Q4 retail season; holiday displays spike July-August

markets.expansionPlan: Nordics and Benelux first (2026 H1), then central Europe

competitors.differentiators: We own the factory (no trading-company margin); CE+UL both covered
competitors.winLoss: We win on price and customization; we lose when buyers need local installation services

signals.noiseExamples: Generic retail news without purchasing intent; job ads for store staff
signals.pushTo: email digest to sales lead; flagged in monthly report

icp.description: European retail-equipment wholesalers and retail chains with 50-500 locations purchasing display fixtures in container volumes
icp.criteriaA: Buys display fixtures in 1+ containers per quarter (strong fit: direct factory buyer)
icp.criteriaB: Distributor purchasing LCL volumes or first-time container trial (moderate fit)
icp.criteriaC: Single-store retailers or buyers of finished shop interiors (weak fit)
icp.weights: purchase volume 40%, role seniority 30%, market match 20%, certifications 10%
icp.sizeThresholds: 50-500 employees ideal; under 20 disqualify unless chain HQ
icp.complianceLimits: GDPR - no personal data beyond business contact roles; no scraped private emails

delivery.acceptanceCriteria: Every A-tier lead carries contact info + one-line match rationale; signals link to sources
delivery.notes: Sales lead prefers WeChat for urgent approvals; email otherwise

crm.system: none currently; plan to adopt HubSpot in 2026

ads.accounts: Google Ads account active since 2023; no LinkedIn account yet
